introHtml: Gray is a versatile neutral that works for any school color combination, from bold primary accents to subtle metallic highlights. Custom gray school spirit apparel and gear let your students, staff, and fans show pride without clashing with existing uniforms or merchandise. Whether you need gray T‑shirts for a pep rally, gray hats for the sidelines, or gray stadium cups for concessions, the neutral base makes your logo and school colors pop. Choose screen printing or embroidery for a clean, professional look that lasts through game after game.
